content.about: The Gambia is a narrow country in West Africa, following the Gambia River inland. It is surrounded by Senegal except at its coast. Its riverbanks are full of birds. Kora music is a cherished tradition.

standout.text: The Gambia is the smallest country on mainland Africa.

didYouKnow: The Gambia is almost entirely surrounded by Senegal.
It is a top birdwatching spot.
Kunta Kinteh Island is linked to the slave trade.
